Changes must preserve the meaning of both persisted updates and rendered blocks.
primary.counterevidence: The mapping pipeline and thread abstractions isolate substantial work; options are cloned before augmentation, and disposed/cancellation guards are explicit. Stream and restore phases are named and commented, making the obligations traceable rather than hidden.

evidence.observation: User history is updated before streaming; stateful conversations may send only new messages with a conversation identifier.

primary.actual_role: Render-tree-backed component parameter view with comparison, snapshots and dual-source enumeration
primary.hardest_behavior: Keep owner-relative frame ranges, contiguous attribute boundaries, snapshot/clone ownership, view lifetime, direct versus cascading enumeration, and conservative equality coherent. A change in frame assumptions affects enumeration, comparison and copies simultaneously.
primary.counterevidence: The type documents that equality is rendering-specific and deliberately conservative. Boundary checks and helper enumerators localize traversal, and most public lookup/conversion methods reuse enumeration. There is no asynchronous scheduling within this file.
primary.inspection_scope: Entire src/Components/Components/src/ParameterView.cs, lines 1-450; source-only inspection, no execution or dependency implementation review.

evidence.observation: Enumeration checks the captured lifetime before exposing frames.
Clone constructs a new owner frame and copies entries while retaining lifetime/owner-index information, so copy-layout assumptions require review.
DefinitelyEquals walks two owner-relative ranges, distinguishes subtree end from attribute-sequence end, and delegates conservative value comparison.
Removal checking and snapshot capture independently depend on owner/attribute frame layout.
Combined enumeration yields direct parameters before cascading values.
Direct enumeration assumes attributes precede other descendants and uses the owner subtree end.

secondary.counterevidence: Comments specify layout and conservative equality rules; operations are decomposed into small enumerators, and equality exits safely on ordering differences rather than solving arbitrary object equivalence.
secondary.inspection_scope: Entire file, lines 1-450; frame producers and callers not inspected.

evidence.observation: Enumeration checks the view lifetime before exposing frame-backed values.
Cloning and cascading attachment construct new views using buffer, owner-index and lifetime assumptions.
Equality walks two subtrees in lockstep, checks both subtree and attribute boundaries, then names and change detection.
Direct-parameter slicing and snapshots depend on attribute contiguity and owner-relative subtree lengths.
Public enumeration transitions permanently from direct parameters to cascading parameters.
Direct enumeration stops at subtree or nonattribute boundaries; cascading values are fetched from their suppliers.
